title: spirillus praelongus

It is native to tropical regions of Central and South America, and its unique, lantern-like flowers have been used in traditional medicine for their potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Spirillus praelongus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which may contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic effects.
